methods.steps: Click the page, choose Insert > File, select the TXT and click Insert, then click OK in the Insert Text dialog. Choose File > Export, select SVG as the file type and save.
methods.limits: SVG shows no options dialog on export.

methods.steps: magick -size 800x -pointsize 16 caption:@note.txt note.png; in Inkscape use File > Import, choose embed, then save SVG.
methods.limits: Bitmap lettering, not text.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i scene.vob -c:a aac -b:a 192k -c:v libx264 -crf 21 scene.mov
methods.limits: Re-encodes the video and audio.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i scene.vob -c copy scene-copy.mov
methods.limits: Stream copy passes packets through without decoding or encoding.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i scene.vob -c:v prores_ks scene-edit.mov
methods.limits: Encodes the video as ProRes.

methods.steps: opusenc --bitrate 128 take.wav take.opus
methods.limits: Reads Wave input and writes an Ogg Opus stream; the bitrate is in kbit/s.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i take.wav -c:a libopus -b:a 128k take.opus
methods.limits: The libopus encoder is a wrapper that requires --enable-libopus.

methods.steps: Choose File > Import > Audio and select the WAV. Then choose File > Export Audio, pick Opus as the format, name the file and export.
methods.limits: Opus is one of the export formats Audacity lists.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i library.wma -vn -c:a aac -b:a 192k listening.m4a
methods.limits: A new lossy encode.

methods.steps: Install the optional FFmpeg library, open the WMA, then choose File > Export Audio and pick M4A(AAC) Files FFmpeg as the format.
methods.limits: The manual warns that the AAC bitrate setting is not always honored.

methods.steps: Choose File > Import, select the WPG file type, click Import and click the page to place it. Then choose File > Export, pick JPG in the Save as type list and click Export.
methods.limits: Corel lists limitations for WPG import.

methods.steps: Open the WPG, then choose File > Export and pick JPEG.
methods.limits: Draw lists WPG among the graphics formats it opens and JPEG among the formats it exports.

methods.steps: magick illustration.wpg illustration.jpg
methods.limits: ImageMagick lists WPG as a format it reads.

methods.steps: Open the XCF in GIMP, choose Windows > Dockable Dialogs > Paths, right-click the path and pick Export Paths, then save the file.
methods.limits: GIMP saves the path in SVG format.

methods.steps: In GIMP choose File > Export As and export a PNG. In Inkscape choose File > Import, pick the PNG, choose embed, and save as SVG.
methods.limits: Keeps pixels instead of vector shapes.

methods.steps: Export the picture as PNG in GIMP and import it into Inkscape. Select it with the Selector tool, choose Path > Trace Bitmap, set the options, click Update and then Ok.
methods.limits: The trace is not an exact copy of the picture.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i speech.aac -vn -c:a flac speech-decoded.flac
methods.limits: Leaves out video streams; the encoder is FLAC.

methods.steps: Choose Media > Convert/Save, add the AAC, click Convert, pick the Audio - FLAC profile, set a .flac destination and click Start.
methods.limits: The profile list includes Audio - FLAC.

methods.steps: magick -density 300 artwork.ai artwork.tiff
methods.limits: -density sets the resolution used when a vector format is rendered.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i master.aiff -c:a aac -b:a 192k listening-from-aiff.m4a
methods.limits: Requests AAC rather than ALAC; AAC is lossy.

methods.steps: Open the AIFF, choose File > Export Audio, select M4A (AAC) Files (FFmpeg) and export.
methods.limits: The optional FFmpeg library is needed.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i archive.avi -c:v libx264 -crf 19 -c:a aac -f mp4 delivery.m4v
methods.limits: A new encode; the player must decode H.264 and AAC.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i archive.avi -c copy -f mp4 copied.m4v
methods.limits: Streams are left unchanged rather than re-encoded.
